_meta.source: Lenovo XCC2 REST API guide + Lenovo Press LP1977 (AMD) / LP1836 (Intel) + public real-device values (SR635 V3) + operator configs
_meta.firmware_version: latest XCC2/UEFI for SR645 V3/SR675 V3/SD650 V3 NOT determined; weka SR635 V3 data has no firmware tag (its file lists SystemBiosVersion 1.7.2 etc. among its keys, recorded as attribute values only)
_meta.status: partial (AMD Genoa: full-key-set proxy from SR635 V3 (1S sibling of SR645 V3); Intel EGS (SD650 V3): tuning subset + operator configs only)

field_semantics.type: null unless the registry entry was published (docs) - type_hint is inferred from the JSON value type of real dumps
field_semantics.allowed_values: Redfish ValueName list; only from published registry entries in docs
field_semantics.allowed_values_display: UI/display choices from Lenovo Press tuning guide; Redfish spelling replaces space/dash/slash with underscore (e.g. "I/O sensitive" -> I_OSensitive) - see observed values
field_semantics.default: only from docs registry; default_display from tuning guide
field_semantics.verification: verified = attribute name seen in >=2 independent sources or a published registry entry; otherwise unverified

_meta.proxy_warning: SR635 V3 is a 1-socket AMD sibling, not a user model. SR645 V3 (2S) / SR675 V3 (GPU) differ in slots, GPU, xGMI/2-socket attributes. SD650 V3 is Intel Sapphire/Emerald Rapids (Eagle Stream): no real dump found; do NOT assume the AMD key set applies.

uris.bios_settings_note: Lenovo has NO /Bios/Settings; the @Redfish.Settings.SettingsObject of Bios points to /Bios/Pending (SupportedApplyTimes: OnReset)
uris.registries_collection: /redfish/v1/Registries (from Lenovo sample scripts: member whose @odata.id contains the Bios.AttributeRegistry name)
uris.patch_example: PATCH /redfish/v1/Systems/1/Bios/Pending {"Attributes": {"<Name>": "<Value>"}} -> 200 RebootRequired; applied on next host reset

doc_xcc2_rest.note: text identical to XCC doc; examples copied from XCC (SR650 CDI340M)

lp1836.note: tuning subset only; guide states update 22 Sep 2026

weka_sr635v3.note: labelled "default/factory reset values" by the repo; firmware version not recorded; 310 keys incl. adapter-specific keys

sapcc_sr650v3.note: settings that operators apply; value style evidence

lenovo_py_redfish.note: URI flow only (Bios -> @Redfish.Settings.SettingsObject = Pending; registry via Registries)

attribute_count_note: union of AMD-Genoa and Intel-EGS sources; per-attribute "observed[].platform"/"tuning_guide[].platform" tells which platform. Not the complete registry of any single model.
